subheadline: Nix led another fourth-quarter comeback, this time over Kansas City, and Denver sits alone atop the AFC West at 6-2.

searchIntent: Broncos fans who saw the comeback over the Chiefs want to know why Nix is trending and which of his jerseys to get.
body: Bo Nix and the Denver Broncos are alone in first place in the AFC West. On Nov. 1 in Denver, Nix brought the Broncos back from an 11-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat the Kansas City Chiefs 28-24, and the defense held at the goal line on the final snaps.
Nix finished 20 of 32 for 222 yards and two touchdowns. Denver is now 6-2.
## Why fans are buying in

Beating Kansas City is the result Broncos fans measure a season by, and this one came with first place attached. It was the third time in his career that Nix has led Denver back from a double-digit deficit in the fourth quarter.
CBS Sports Research puts him at 12-12 in games where he has trailed in the final quarter, the best such record for any quarterback since 1970. That is the kind of number that builds a reputation.

His season has not always been smooth, and Denver's offense has had quiet stretches. He keeps winning late anyway, and in our view fans tend to rally behind the quarterback who delivers in the last few minutes.

He was already one of the league's most popular players. On the NFLPA's year-end Top 50 player sales list, which covers licensed player merchandise from March 1, 2025, to Feb. 28, 2026, Nix ranked No. 11. That list counts all licensed player products, not jerseys alone. See where he stands among the [top selling NFL jerseys](/top-selling-nfl-jerseys/).
## The look

Nix wears No. 10. His jersey comes in Denver's classic orange, the white road look and the navy alternate, and the banner above shows each style. Our pick for game day in Denver is the orange, while the navy alternate stands out for fans who want something less common.
## Why this jersey will last

Nix is a young starter leading his division in November, with a defense that can close out games. That is the setup for a long run in Broncos jerseys, and a playoff push would only add to it. This is our analysis, not a sales figure.

headline: Bhayshul Tuten Just Gave Jaguars Fans a Reason to Wear No. 33
title: Bhayshul Tuten Jersey: The Jaguars Back's Breakout Day
subheadline: The second-year back ran and caught his way into Jacksonville's record book in a 42-7 win over Indianapolis.
description: Bhayshul Tuten became the first Jaguar with 100 rushing yards, 50 receiving yards and a score each way in one game. Why his No. 33 jersey is on the rise.
searchIntent: Jaguars and fantasy fans who saw Tuten's big game want to know who he is, why he is breaking out and where to get his jersey.
body: Bhayshul Tuten did something on Nov. 1 that no Jaguars player had done before. In a 42-7 win over the Indianapolis Colts, the second-year running back ran for 104 yards and a touchdown and caught two passes for 55 yards and another score.
That made him the first player in franchise history with at least 100 rushing yards, 50 receiving yards, a rushing touchdown and a receiving touchdown in the same game.
## Why fans are buying in

Tuten is a breakout in the truest sense. Jacksonville picked him in the fourth round of the 2025 draft, and this season he took over as the lead back from Travis Etienne. Through the first seven weeks, Pro Football Focus graded him as the highest-rated running back in the league.

The touchdowns keep coming. He has scored twice in back-to-back games and now has three rushing and three receiving touchdowns this season, with three more wiped out by penalties. His scores against Indianapolis came on a 39-yard run and a 25-yard catch.

A back who can hurt a defense on the ground and through the air gets noticed quickly, and in our view that is exactly what is happening with Tuten. The win was Jacksonville's fifth of the season, and a lopsided division victory makes the Jaguars look like a team with him at the center of things.
## The look

Tuten wears No. 33. His jersey comes in Jacksonville's teal, including the team's teal alternate, and the banner above shows the options. Teal is the color fans most connect with the franchise, which makes it an easy pick for game day.
## Why this jersey will last

A 23-year-old who has earned the lead role is the kind of player fans pick up early, before the rest of the league catches on. This is our analysis, not a sales figure, but the signs point one way: a bigger role, more touches and a team that is winning with him.

subheadline: The 19-year-old scored a career-high 38 and tied the NBA rookie record with nine 3-pointers in Memphis.
description: Darius Acuff Jr. scored 38 and tied the NBA rookie record with nine 3-pointers on Oct. 31. Here is why the Kings rookie's No. 5 jersey is one to get early.
searchIntent: NBA fans who saw Acuff's record night want to know how good the Kings rookie has been and where to get his jersey.
body: Darius Acuff Jr. is giving Sacramento fans a reason to tune in. On Oct. 31 at Memphis, the 19-year-old rookie scored a career-high 38 points and made nine 3-pointers, tying the NBA rookie record for threes in a game. He is the first teenager to do it.
The Kings lost 136-105 and are still looking for their first win, but Acuff has quickly become the story of their season.
## Why fans are buying in

Sacramento drafted Acuff seventh overall in 2026 out of Arkansas, and he has had the ball in his hands from the opening night. Through six games he has scored 158 points, an average of 26.3 per game, with three 30-point nights.
The 38 came two nights after he posted 34 points and 14 assists against New Orleans. That made him the youngest King to score 30 or more in back-to-back games, passing a mark held by Oscar Robertson.
The Pelicans game also put him on a short list with Michael Jordan, Trae Young and Steve Francis as the only rookies with at least 34 points, 14 assists, six rebounds and a steal in one game.
The shooting is turning, too. He missed all seven of his 3-point tries in his debut, then went 9 of 14 from deep in Memphis.
## The look
Acuff wears No. 5. His jersey is available in the Kings' black Icon Edition, shown in the banner above. It is a bold, simple look for a player who has made a bold start.
## Why this jersey will last

A rookie point guard who scores like this becomes the face of a rebuild. In our view, the wins will come as the roster grows around him, and fans who pick up his jersey now will have had it from the start. That is our analysis, not a sales claim.
